sentences.japanese: ボクが憧れたのは翔太部長の『力』じゃない。体を張ってでも信念を貫こうとする雄々しい勇気だったはず。
sentences.english: What I looked up to in Shota was not his 'strength'. It was his heroic courage to put his life on the line to carry out his convictions.

sentences.japanese: 雄のくじゃくは尾の羽毛が色彩豊かである。
sentences.english: The male peacock has colorful tail feathers.

sentences.japanese: 雌の鵞鳥のソースになるものは雄の鵞鳥のソースにもなる。
sentences.english: What is sauce for the goose is sauce for the gander.

sentences.japanese: 犬は３匹いますが、１匹が雄であとは雌です。
sentences.english: I have three dogs; one is male and the others are female.

sentences.japanese: 陰茎は雄の生殖器のひとつ。
sentences.english: The penis is one of the male reproductive organs.
